raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
​With over 18 years of experience, I lead the design and development of scalable, interoperable, and reusable machine learning and data pipeline components as a Lead Data & MLOps Engine​er. I specialize in Data Engineering, Analytics, and MLOps, leveraging GCP (BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc), Python (Vertex AI), and Kubeflow to build high-performing, automated, and reliable systems that enable data-driven decision-making.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Cloud Platforms:
GCP (BigQuery, Vertex AI, Dataflow, Dataproc, DataFusion, Composer, Spanner)
MLOps Tools:
Kubeflow, MLflow, GitHub Actions, Docker, Artifact Registry, Vertex AI Pipelines — expertise in end-to-end pipeline automation, CI/CD integration, and model lifecycle management.
Data Engineering:
Python, PySpark, BigQuery, Dataproc, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Airflow, dbt, ETL/ELT, Data Quality & Governance, Schema Enforcement
Orchestration:
Airflow, Composer, Cloud Build, Jenkins
Data Modeling & Warehousing:
Logical Data Models across Financial Services, Communication, and Retail domains.
Database & Query Optimization:
BigQuery (nested/repeated fields, UNNEST, de-normalization, partitioning, sharding, index, Row and Column Level Security), MySQL, Teradata — optimizing queries for performance and cost efficiency.
Feature Engineering & ML Techniques:
Standardization, Logarithmic Transformation, One-Hot Encoding, Imputation, Outlier Handling, Binning
Forecasting & Analytics:
ARIMA+, SARIMA, Prophet, Regression, Ensemble Models — specialized in time-series forecasting, model drift detection, and ensemble evaluation for sales, demand, and promotional uplift forecasting.
CI/CD & Automation:
GitHub, Cloud Build, Terraform, Jenkins, Composer
Security & Governance:
IAM, dbt RLS/CLS (i.e. Row and Column Level Security)
Leadership:
Team Mentorship, Solution Architecture, Stakeholder Management, Agile (SAFe) — proven leadership in mentoring, project delivery, and cross-functional collaboration with global data science and analytics teams.
Skills: VertexAI · BigQuery · MLOps · Kubeflow · MLFlow · Docker · GKE · Airflow · Dataflow · Dataproc
Vodafone India Services Pvt. Ltd.
GCP Data Engineer / Analyst
Aug 2020 – Aug 2022 | Pune, Maharashtra, India (Hybrid)
Migrated enterprise data pipelines from ANT → MySQL → Teradata and from Teradata/Hadoop → GCS → BigQuery, improving query efficiency and reducing latency.
Designed and implemented ETL pipelines using GCP DataFusion for cleansing, deduplication, and transformation workflows with improved maintainability.
Optimized BigQuery performance using partitioning, clustering, and cost-aware query design.
Developed and orchestrated Apache Airflow DAGs (Composer) for dynamic Dataproc cluster management and PySpark job submission.
Skills: Teradata · MySQL · AWS Lambda · ANT · Alibaba Cloud · Hive · PySpark · Google BigQuery
Sears Holdings India Pvt. Ltd.
GCP Data Engineer / ETL & DWH Specialist
Aug 2014 – Aug 2020 | Pune, Maharashtra, India (On-site)
Built Enterprise Data Warehouse
Automated ingestion and transformation for 50+ data sources using config-driven pipelines, improving scalability and reducing batch processing time by 40%.
Achieved 99.9% pipeline uptime while optimizing costs via auto-scaling Dataflow pipelines, BQ reservations, and Coldline/Archive storage strategies.
Migrated and provisioned data from HDFS, Oracle, SAP, Teradata to GCP BigQuery using TPT, Sqoop, gsutil, and bq CLI, ensuring reliability and consistency.
Architected PySpark-based transformation pipelines converting heterogeneous data (Flat/JSON/XML) into AVRO format directly consumed by BigQuery.
Designed real-time ingestion using Pub/Sub → Dataflow, implementing watermarking, windowing, and side inputs for streaming analytics.
Skills: Google BigQuery · Python · PySpark · Hive · Sqoop · GitLab · Dataproc · Spanner
Infosys Ltd.
Data Management and Operations Lead (Oracle, Teradata, Informatica, Autosys)
Jul 2013 – Aug 2014 | Pune, Maharashtra, India (On-site)
Led and managed a 20-member cross-functional team across Oracle, Teradata, and Informatica, driving full lifecycle delivery of data integration and analytics solutions.
Directed reverse engineering and source-to-target mapping from Informatica Designer, improving documentation, maintainability, and data traceability.
Implemented data validation and reconciliation frameworks to detect and recover missing or failed records in sales and purchase order workflows.
Skills: Teradata · Informatica · Oracle · Autosys
IBM India Pvt. Ltd.
ETL/DWH Developer (Teradata & Oracle Data Integrator)
Jul 2012 – Jul 2013 | Pune, India
Developed a Teradata Stored Procedure (Scheduler) framework to streamline ETL orchestration, improving efficiency and scalability of daily batch runs. That handles alerting for data latency, failure, and throughput issues.
Configured Oracle Data Integrator (ODI) and Teradata environments, including driver setup, reverse engineering, global filter application, and transformation logic.
Skills: Teradata · Oracle Data Integrator (ODI)
Barclays Global Service Centre
Analyst – ELT / DWH (Teradata, Mainframe)
Jul 2010 – Jul 2012 | Pune, Maharashtra, India
Developed Teradata (Mainframe) BTEQ scripts for SCD1 and SCD2 implementations, ensuring historical data accuracy and auditability.
Resolved data integrity and reconciliation issues in financial systems (e.g., Novated Agreements, Missing Deals).
Supported BASEL II to BASEL III transition, ensuring regulatory compliance and accurate capital reporting.
Skills: Teradata · Mainframe · BTEQ · SQL
Wipro Infotech Ltd.
Data Engineer – ELT / DWH (Teradata, Oracle PL/SQL)
Jul 2009 – Jun 2010 | Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
Designed procedures to extract and transfer data from three databases (LOBs) via FTP, automating multi-source data delivery.
Customized FSLDM models per business requirements and implemented SCD1/SCD2 logic for warehouse data management.
Conducted data quality checks (BODI) on source systems using PL/SQL and DUMP utilities, ensuring clean and accurate loads.
Skills: Teradata · SAP BusinessObjects · Oracle PL/SQL · BODI
Exilant Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
Software Engineer (Java Developer | SQL)
Jun 2007 – Jul 2009 | Bangalore, India
Developed in-house projects like VIVO, eRAD, TIME, and WHO, enhancing internal productivity and system visibility.
Supported workflow automation and configuration, integrating backend data validation with front-end dashboards.
Skills: Java · JavaScript · PL/SQL · Oracle · T-SQL · Teradata SQL
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
​General Mills India Pvt. Ltd.   
Lead Data Engineer / MLOps Specialist
Aug 2022 – Present | Mumbai, Maharashtra, India (Hybrid)
Led the design and development of the Scenario Planning Tool for forecasting baseline and promotional sales volumes using a two-stage hybrid model (ARIMA+, Linear Regression), improving forecast precision.
Designed ML and Data pipelines on GCP (BigQuery, Dataflow, Composer) to support large-scale forecasting and high-availability workloads, enabling near real-time sales and demand insights.
Developed and productionized time series models (ARIMA+, SARIMA, Prophet) in Vertex AI and Kubeflow for ingestion, feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning, training, evaluation, inference, and deployment.
Refactored (R to Python and monolithic to modularized) and automated Vertex AI pipelines for batch and online prediction, incorporating weighted-average logic for display bins, improving accuracy and flexibility.
Built modular, reusable transformation pipelines using dbt with embedded data-quality tests, lineage tracking, and governance controls in BigQuery, ensuring transparent, auditable, and compliant ML operations.
Implemented enterprise-grade CI/CD automation via GitHub Actions + Vertex AI + Kubeflow, triggering end-to-end pipeline runs on code or image updates, ensuring reproducible deployments across environments.
Developed dbt-based modular transformation pipelines with data-quality tests, schema enforcement, and RLS/CLS for secured access in BigQuery.
Managed Artifact Registry for secure, versioned storage and deployment of containerized (Docker) ML environments, supporting consistent pipelines.
Mentored a cross-functional team of engineers and analysts, promoting best practices in time-series modeling, CI/CD, governance, observability, and automation, driving MLOps maturity.
Modernized legacy workflows into GCP-native, version-controlled architectures, improving scalability, reliability, and developer productivity while reducing manual workload.
